start_here: Say to your AI: "When do my proof accounts' sign-ins end?" It runs tool:read-when-the-proof-session-ends.
no_lists_because: Its only state is vault values (proof-sessions, proof-sign-in-code), never rows; the proof accounts are the Workshop DATA proof-accounts.json.
instructions: 1. The vault holds proof-sessions (JSON keyed by origin), put once by the vault owner and kept by workflow:keep-the-proof-sessions-signed-in.
2. Run the tool with no input.
3. Read renew (true when an account has no session or one that ends within renew_when_days_left) and each origin's expires_at, days_left and cookie names. No cookie value is ever answered.

worked_examples.title: Read when each proof sign-in ends
worked_examples.ask: When do my proof accounts' sign-ins end?
worked_examples.answer: renew and each origin with its end and days left.
